rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 for System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource in DeviceConfigClient net8.0
Found App.config with binding redirect newVersion=10.0.0.3
Traced AppConfigFile into RAR for all TFMs including net8.0
Explained RAR unifying to 10.0.0.3 conflicting with actual 10.0.0.0
Noted the misleading error message artifact
Proposed removing hardcoded redirect / relying on AutoGenerateBindingRedirects

scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
scenarios.reasoning: A thorough, well-evidenced investigation with node-level citations, per-TFM cross-check, and a concrete actionable fix. Main shortfall: it never actually read App.config's XML (a specific task requirement), relying on inference, and some tool-call effort was wasted chasing saved output files. Otherwise near-excellent.
